latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Jiggle, an AI-powered video stabilization skill.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB with 1080p MP4 export.
- Removes camera shake from handheld or action footage in 20–40 seconds via cloud GPU processing.
- Handles all connection, session, and rendering workflows automatically—no installation required.
- User-friendly: just upload your clip and describe the desired result.
- Includes error handling, session management, and common workflow tips for smooth usage.
